Script.name: EmunahBootstrap
Script.script:
-- Emunah bootstrap. -- -- This is the entire Mudlet-resident part of the system. Everything else is plain Lua on -- disk in the checkout, loaded by src/emunah.lua and reloadable with `emreload` without -- reimporting anything. -- -- That split is the whole point of the loading model: the package you -- install never changes, so you edit modules in a real editor, hit reload, and keep -- playing. Compare the usual Mudlet workflow, where every change means re-importing a -- package and losing your in-memory state.
local CANDIDATES = { -- Preferred: a clone inside the Mudlet home directory. -- -- NOTE the directory is EmunahSrc, not Emunah. A directory named after the package -- sitting inside the profile is dangerous: Mudlet's package manager removes a -- package's own directory on uninstall/reinstall, which would delete your working -- copy. Keeping the source under a different name means the package manager never -- touches it. Never symlink your git checkout into the profile either -- the same -- cleanup follows the link and deletes the repo. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/EmunahSrc", -- GitHub's "Download ZIP" unpacks with a -main suffix; accept it so the zip route -- works without anyone having to rename a directory. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Emunah-main", getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Emunah-master", }
local function exists(path) local file = io.open(path .. "/src/emunah.lua", "r") if file then file:close() return true end return false end
-- EMUNAH_ROOT itself is just a Lua global: it does not survive a fresh Mudlet start, only -- a mid-session `emreload`. Without something on disk, "point the bootstrap at your -- checkout (once; it is remembered per profile)" would not actually be true -- every -- restart would fail with "Could not find the Emunah source" until EMUNAH_ROOT was set by -- hand again. This file is that memory: written once EMUNAH_ROOT actually resolves to a -- real checkout, read back before falling to the CANDIDATES guesses. local ROOT_FILE = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/emunah-root.txt"
local function loadRememberedRoot() local file = io.open(ROOT_FILE, "r") if not file then return nil end local path = file:read("*l") file:close() return path and path ~= "" and path or nil end
local function rememberRoot(path) local file = io.open(ROOT_FILE, "w") if not file then return end file:write(path) file:close() end
local function locate() -- An explicit override always wins; set EMUNAH_ROOT in a script if you keep the -- checkout somewhere else (a dotfiles repo, a shared drive). This is the recommended -- setup: point it at your git clone outside the profile entirely. if EMUNAH_ROOT and exists(EMUNAH_ROOT) then return EMUNAH_ROOT end
local remembered = loadRememberedRoot() if remembered and exists(remembered) then return remembered end
for _, candidate in ipairs(CANDIDATES) do if exists(candidate) then return candidate end end return nil end
--- Entry point. --- --- The name matters. A Mudlet script with an eventHandlerList invokes a global function --- named exactly after the script, by building `return <ScriptName>` and compiling it -- --- so a script called "Emunah Bootstrap" produces `return Emunah Bootstrap`, which is not --- valid Lua and fails on every registered event. The script is therefore named --- EmunahBootstrap, and this function has to match it character for character. function EmunahBootstrap() local root = locate()
if not root then cecho("\n<ansi_red>[emunah]<reset> Could not find the Emunah source.\n") cecho("<ansi_light_black> Clone it somewhere outside the profile and point at it:<reset>\n") cecho("<ansi_cyan> lua EMUNAH_ROOT = \"/path/to/Emunah\"; EmunahBootstrap()<reset>\n") cecho("<ansi_light_black> ...or clone into <reset><ansi_cyan>" .. getMudletHomeDir() .. "/EmunahSrc<reset>\n") return false end
EMUNAH_ROOT = root rememberRoot(root)
local ok, err = pcall(dofile, root .. "/src/emunah.lua") if not ok then cecho(string.format("\n<ansi_red>[emunah]<reset> Bootstrap failed: %s\n", tostring(err))) return false end return true end
-- Lowercase alias, for typing by hand. emunahBootstrap = EmunahBootstrap
-- Load now (covers package install and profile start), and again on connect so that a -- profile opened before the checkout existed picks it up without a restart. EmunahBootstrap()
if emunahBootstrapHandler then killAnonymousEventHandler(emunahBootstrapHandler) end emunahBootstrapHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() if not emunah then EmunahBootstrap() end end)
